subject.title: fix(sqlite): stop mount probes blocking database startup

question: Should SQLite database opening retain a bounded synchronous mount probe, or must filesystem classification be prepared outside the open path?
rationale: The patch trades an indefinite hang for a deliberate one-second event-loop block and conservative journal-mode change; repository policy and the shared state/plugin caller surface make that an owner-level availability and compatibility choice.

options.title: Move classification outside open
options.body: Prepare or process-cache filesystem classification before synchronous database setup and use conservative rollback journaling when no prepared result exists.

options.title: Accept the bounded probe
options.body: Keep the one-second synchronous probe only with explicit owner acceptance and supported-host proof covering repeated state and plugin database opens.

recommendation.title: Move classification outside open
recommendation.body: Prepare or process-cache filesystem classification before synchronous database setup and use conservative rollback journaling when no prepared result exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and have directly stewarded the latest SQLite patch revisions.
